title: Chinese Hackers Abused Google Workspace Rules to Steal Research and Defense Emails
summary: A China-linked espionage group hid inside North American medical, academic, and military research networks for more than a year, quietly stealing sensitive research and defense email.
card_summary: A China-linked espionage group hid inside North American medical, academic, and military research networks for more than a year, quietly stealing sensitive research and defense email.

sections.technical: The way in was a backdoor on their REDCap research servers that stole login credentials.

email_summary: A China-linked espionage group hid inside North American medical, academic, and military research networks for more than a year, quietly stealing sensitive research and defense email. The way in was a backdoor on their REDCap research servers that stole login credentials.

title: North Korean Hackers Are Turning Developer Tools Into Malware Delivery Channels
summary: Cybersecurity researchers have flagged two malicious cyber campaigns that exhibit similarities with a persistent North Korean threat cluster known as Contagious Interview (aka Famous Chollima, HexagonalRodent, and Void Dokkaebi).
